product.title: Multi-Game Card Bundle — 20+ Cards
product.descriptionHtml:
Multi-Game Card Bundle — 20+ Cards — sourced and condition-verified by HOKO Collectables.

📦 Shipping

Australia only. Postage within Australia: $3 untracked letter. Dispatched within 1–3 business days, Monday to Friday, from Victoria, Australia. Combined postage applies automatically on multiple items.

✨ How We Pack

Raw singles: sleeved → toploader → bubble wrap → stiffened mailer. Foils get foil-safe packing. Shipped to arrive in NM condition.

🎴 Condition Grading

HOKO uses a three-point scale: Near Mint (close to mint, possible minor edgewear or scratching), Played (visible wear — indents, whitening, nicks, scuffs), Damaged (major edgewear, bends, creases, tears). Cards scanned individually; we err toward the lower grade.

🤝 About HOKO

Victoria-based, collector-run. 20 years in the hobby. Honest grading, careful packing. Email support@hokocollectables.com or DM @hoko.collectables.
